title: Moyva parallel audit run header
description: Machine-readable identity header for every audit run/snapshot. One header per run; each snapshot inside a run carries its own snapshot.sequence/frame/time. Produced by collect_run_header.py (environment/git part) merged with a runtime probe (capture_runtime_snapshot.cs via unity eval_file) when an Editor is available; consumed by Q01 acceptance review. Verified against base 98d86e11f1fd905d7e90b6b7a4e8c30dc6b20e38.

taskId.description: Audit task ID, e.g. A00, C01, G09, U04, Q01.

owner.description: Owning worktree branch, e.g. night/moyva/20260927-113705/a00 or work/moyva/a00-reviewed. One mutation authority per ID.

baseSha.description: Actual commit SHA the run started from (git rev-parse HEAD of the worktree). The wave coordinator pins this; never a moving remote HEAD.

treeSha.description: git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; compared across wave worktrees to prove identical base content.

seed.description: Requested world seed: GameLaunchContext.Seed when the menu/new-game path configured it, else GeneratorMapRecipe.Seed, else 0. 0 means 'not pinned' and resolves to GlobalSeed.DefaultSeed (=42) via MapSeedService.Resolve.

resolvedSeed.description: Seed that MapGenerationPipeline.Generate fed to GlobalSeed.InitializeDeterministic (request.SeedOverride ?? MapSeedService.Resolve(recipe)). Null before generation ran.

normalizedSeed.description: GlobalSeed.Normalize(seed): 0 -> 1. The deterministic value that seeds all generator hashing.

globalSeedCurrent.description: Kruty1918.Moyva.Generator.Runtime.GlobalSeed.Current at capture time; null if not readable (editor-stopped probe).

unityRandomInitialized.description: True only when GlobalSeed.InitializeDeterministic ran in this session (it also calls UnityEngine.Random.InitState). Null when not observable.

fixtureId.description: ID from audit-seeds.json, e.g. audit-s01-default. Empty when running an ad-hoc seed.

requestedMapType.description: Map type as requested. Domain depends on source: MapType {continents,pangaea,islands,highlands,desert,random} for GameLaunchContext.MapType / lobby DTOs; MapTypePreset {balanced,continental,island,mountain,plains} for WorldCreationConfig.MapType. Empty string when not requested.

resolvedArchetype.description: Engine archetype AFTER resolution. At base 98d86e11 the recipe-driven pipeline consumes no MapType->archetype mapping: WorldArchetypeResolver/WorldGeographyEngine are only exercised by tests. Emit 'not-resolved' and identify the world shape by recipeId instead. A future MapType consumer must update this field to the resolved value.

recipeId.description: id of the GeneratorMapRecipe JSON actually loaded by IMapGenerationEnvironment (e.g. 'testgeneratorrecipe' from Assets/Moyva/Presets/Generator/recipes/). This is the real resolved generator profile.

width.description: Final width AFTER MapSizeResolver + MapChunkSizePolicy.CropAxis (chunk-multiple, min 16). From WorldGeneratedDataSignal.Width or grid service.

height.description: Final height after the same policy; from WorldGeneratedDataSignal.Height.

source.description: Which authority produced width/height, per MapSizeResolver precedence: 'launch-context' | 'recipe-shared-settings' | 'requested' | 'signal' | 'unknown'.

kind.description: Capture environment. editor-stopped headers are environment probes, NOT gameplay evidence.

playMode.description: EditorApplication.isPlaying/isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode + isPaused mapped; 'paused' is the Unity play-mode pause, distinct from game pause.

gameState.description: IGameStateService.CurrentState (GameStateType) lowercased. gameState=paused is the GAME pause (GamePausedSignal{IsPaused=true}), not a harness stop.

launchMode.description: GameLaunchContext.Mode (GameLaunchMode enum name), e.g. MenuNewGame, MenuBotGame, DirectGameplay, Unknown.

timeScale.description: Time.timeScale at capture. GameStateService.PauseGame sets it to 0 ONLY when IGamePauseModePolicy.IsMultiplayerSessionActive is false; null when not observable.

pauseOwnsTimeScale.description: GameStateService._ownsSimulationPause equivalent: whether the pause subsystem currently owns timeScale=0. Distinguishes game pause (true) from a stopped/backgrounded editor (false/null).

fps.description: Measured frames per second over the sampling window; null when not measured (e.g. editor-stopped probe).

frameTimeMs.description: CPU frame time in ms over the sampling window (e.g. mean of Time.deltaTime or frameTiming.cpuFrameTimeMs when a stats source exists); null when not measured.

sequence.description: Harness-assigned monotonic snapshot counter within the run. Every snapshot MUST have a distinct sequence; reuse invalidates the set.

frame.description: UnityEngine.Time.frameCount at capture; null in editor-stopped mode.

gameTime.description: UnityEngine.Time.time (scaled game seconds); null when not in play mode. A frozen value during pause distinguishes game pause from harness downtime.

wallTimeUtc.description: Real UTC timestamp of the snapshot; keeps advancing while the game is paused.

startupSequence.description: WorldGeneratedDataSignal.StartupSequence (long) for the world this snapshot belongs to.

snapshotRevision.description: WorldGeneratedDataSignal.SnapshotRevision; distinguishes regenerated worlds within one session.

worktree.description: Filesystem path of the owning worktree.

pipelinePort.description: unity CLI pipeline port from 'unity status' when a live editor serves the worktree.

editorPid.description: PID of the Unity.exe serving THIS worktree; used to never signal a foreign editor.

collector.description: Tool that produced the header, e.g. collect_run_header.py/1 + capture_runtime_snapshot.cs/1.
